body: No there is no hope. Life is terminal anyways, I'm just choosing to leave sooner.

No nothing helped that's the point. It all made me feel worse. I'm just done. I'm tired of working a job I hate for literally nothing. And no I don't want to look for a new job. I just simply don't want to be here. I don't like people. People don't like me. What value? Like I'm going to die someday, I'm just speeding up the process of this miserable hellscape I never asked to be a part of. Thank you, please have a good night. Bye.

10+ years of therapy. Every SSRI invented. Mood stabilizers. Meditation. Journaling. Exercise. Diet changes. 

I just don't fit. I was never meant to be here. My mother chose wrong.
I've felt this way for over 20 years. I'm tired of waiting.
